applicationDates.reference: Chapter III Sections 1–3 except Art.6(5); Art.6(2)/Annex III
Chapter III Sections 1–3 except Art.6(5); Art.6(1)/Annex I
Art.50 general transparency requirements; transitions assessed separately

regulatorySnapshot.guidance: Approve provision-specific applicability and transition analysis; use readiness labels before applicable dates. Explorer/consolidation aids research; authentic Official Journal acts govern. Art.10(5) has been deleted; current sensitive-category bias processing requires assessment of Art.4a and data-protection law.

defaults.coverageRule: Unknown, not_run, inconclusive and error do not count as pass.
defaults.statement: Diagnostics support an audit assessment and do not constitute legal compliance or a conformity certificate.

items.title: Engagement acceptance and independence
items.objective: Establish a defensible engagement mandate, competence and independence.

procedures.text: Inspect objective, criteria, intended audience, assurance/agreed-procedure basis and signed terms.
Record conflicts, prior implementation services and team independence; assign an independent reviewer.
Assess management integrity, data rights/access, specialists, timetable and resource feasibility.
Obtain lead approval of acceptance and all open pre-fieldwork conditions.

items.signOffGate: Lead accepts the engagement and verifies independence before fieldwork.

items.title: System inventory, boundary and operator roles
items.objective: Identify the complete AI system, versions, roles and decision consequences.

procedures.text: Inventory models, preprocessing, thresholds, interfaces, deployments and downstream human decisions.
Document provider/deployer/importer/distributor entities and supplier responsibility allocation.
Capture intended use, actual use, market geography, affected persons, first service/release dates and material changes.
Pin model/data/code versions and identify exclusions and their effect on audit conclusions.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Regulatory scope and risk classification
items.objective: Approve scope, category flags and provision-specific applicability.

procedures.text: Screen prohibited practices against current legal text and escalate suspected matches.
Evaluate current Article 6 conditions, Annex I/III use cases, exceptions and profiling with evidence.
Evaluate transparency flags independently of high-risk classification.
Record legal version, provision dates, transition rules, unresolved facts and reassessment triggers.
Obtain independent approval; unknown answers leave classification pending.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Risk assessment and qualitative materiality
items.objective: Prioritize audit responses by health, safety, rights and operational consequences.

procedures.text: Identify harm scenarios, reasonably foreseeable misuse, vulnerable groups and affected populations.
Score inherent/residual risk with evidence and document uncertainty.
Apply qualitative overrides for serious harm, prohibited behavior and legal significance.
Aggregate systemic and interacting risks; map each material risk to procedures.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Audit program and approved test criteria
items.objective: Approve a tailored manual and automated program before results are observed.

procedures.text: Select controls using approved applicability; justify removed/modified standard procedures.
Approve task-specific metrics, thresholds, cohort definitions, uncertainty and evidence prerequisites.
Define control reliance, specialists, owners, schedule and review gates.
Pin program/policy versions and require approval for substantive changes.

items.signOffGate: Lead approves scope, program and threshold policies before computation.

items.title: Population completeness and sampling
items.objective: Create reproducible samples with explicit limits on inference.

procedures.text: Reconcile source population, period and sample unit before selection.
Assess related/time-ordered records and define strata/exclusions.
Document statistical precision/confidence or judgmental rationale and sample-size basis.
Retain selection ids, seed, expansion rules and deviations; prohibit unsupported population generalization.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Evidence requests, access and confidentiality
items.objective: Obtain appropriate evidence with authorized handling and defined custody.

procedures.text: Create requests with owner, purpose, period, version, due date and confidentiality.
Verify model/data/code rights, privacy conditions and approved access scope.
Document custody, quarantine, integrity and secure exchange procedures.
Assess missing evidence early and record scope implications.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Lifecycle risk management system
items.objective: Assess documented lifecycle identification, treatment and reassessment of risks.

procedures.text: Trace sampled risks through identification, mitigation, testing and residual-risk acceptance.
Challenge misuse, vulnerable-group harms, interactions and completeness with domain specialists.
Reconcile material risks to predefined metrics, thresholds and versioned validation evidence.
Inspect monitoring/incident-driven risk updates and accountability.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Data governance, lineage and representativeness
items.objective: Assess suitability, provenance, quality and population coverage of data.

procedures.text: Trace records/features/labels to sources and versioned transformations.
Run quality and split/leakage checks with reconciled populations.
Compare relevant group, geographic, language, time and context coverage with intended use.
Assess label construct validity, historical bias, gaps and feedback controls.
Confirm approved current privacy basis before processing sensitive categories.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Fairness and discriminatory-impact diagnostics
items.objective: Evaluate potential group disparities with context, uncertainty and follow-up.

procedures.text: Approve favorable outcome, reference groups, minimum counts, intersectional plan and metrics.
Run selection-rate parity/disparate impact and outcome-conditioned error-rate comparisons where prerequisites hold.
Report counts, uncertainty, undefined metrics and privacy suppression without treating small cohorts as passes.
Investigate diagnostic signals and mitigation tradeoffs using domain evidence.
Form a human assessment; policy thresholds are not EU legal safe harbors.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Technical documentation and Annex IV evidence index
items.objective: Evaluate completeness, correctness and currency of system technical documentation.

procedures.text: Map every applicable Annex IV subitem to accountable owner and evidence versions.
Compile approved facts and identify missing/stale/inconsistent items.
Reconcile actual architecture, instructions, tested metrics and lifecycle changes.
Evaluate exclusions and missing provider declarations; do not generate unsupported statements.
Review the generated package against the real system.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Automatic operational logs and traceability
items.objective: Assess the audited AI system's event recording and retrieval.

procedures.text: Define relevant events/version/correlation ids and compare to intended-use needs.
Reconcile operational decisions/inferences to log populations and sample gaps.
Observe override, stop, error/outage/retry/change logging and retrieval.
Inspect integrity/access/privacy/retention and relevant special logging conditions.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Deployer instructions and usable interpretability
items.objective: Assess whether deployers can interpret outputs and use the system appropriately.

procedures.text: Reconcile instructions and claims with versioned metrics, purpose, limitations and input contract.
Review oversight, maintenance, monitoring and operational instructions for completeness.
Observe representative deployer tasks and comprehension of limitations.
Evaluate explanation artifacts for fidelity/stability and context; explanations are not causal proof.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Explanation fidelity and stability
items.objective: Assess whether diagnostic explanations are suitable evidence for the intended user task.

procedures.text: Approve explanation background population, features and representative cases.
Run supported SHAP/LIME/permutation methods with versioned configuration.
Assess correlated-feature effects, stability, fidelity and computational limitations.
Corroborate with user needs and comprehension; do not equate a plot with effective oversight.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Human oversight design and operating effectiveness
items.objective: Assess accountable people and effective oversight in actual operations.

procedures.text: Inspect authority, competence, workload, training and escalation assignments.
Observe recognition of limitations, automation bias, interpretation and challenge.
Walk through appropriate disregard/override/stop and safe recovery scenarios.
Sample real oversight events and assess relevant special verification obligations.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Performance, calibration and validation
items.objective: Assess task-appropriate performance for the intended use and populations.

procedures.text: Approve metric, error cost, baseline, threshold and uncertainty policy.
Verify locked holdout independence and appropriate group/time-aware cross-validation.
Run task-specific overall/slice metrics and calibration when probabilities drive decisions.
Reconcile performance claims with instructions and disclose generalization limits.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Robustness, stability and distribution drift
items.objective: Evaluate plausible shifts/failures and diagnostic signals of distribution change.

procedures.text: Approve feasible perturbations/threat assumptions and fallback criteria.
Run constrained missingness/noise/domain/text perturbation tests.
Pin drift windows/bins/scales and run PSI, KS and Wasserstein where suitable.
Assess counts, effect sizes, multiple-testing policy and operational meaning.
Corroborate signals with performance/label evidence; absence of drift is not proof of stable outcomes.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Cybersecurity and model supply chain
items.objective: Assess system security through threat-based technical and organizational evidence.

procedures.text: Inspect threat model, model/data/code provenance and dependency inventory.
Evaluate identity, secrets, access, integrity, patching and supplier controls.
Obtain scoped security assessment for relevant poisoning/evasion/extraction and infrastructure threats.
Inspect detection, incidents, recovery and outstanding vulnerabilities.
Review evidence of isolated handling for executable model artifacts.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Quality management and governance
items.objective: Assess relevant accountable governance and quality management processes.

procedures.text: Inspect documented responsibilities, approvals, design/change controls and quality processes.
Sample control operation, supplier management, training and escalations.
Reconcile governance procedures to actual product releases and risk decisions.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Documentation retention and controlled records
items.objective: Assess applicable retention, accessibility, integrity and lawful disposal.

procedures.text: Map retention by obligation/operator/artifact and assess conflicting needs.
Test retrieval, access restrictions, integrity and legal-hold behavior.
Sample retention expiry/disposal and verify minimization of unnecessary personal data.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Value-chain responsibilities and substantial changes
items.objective: Assess operator responsibility allocation and changes that alter roles.

procedures.text: Inspect supplier/operator contracts and actual responsibilities.
Assess rebranding, modifications and intended-purpose changes against current criteria.
Obtain missing provider information and document reliance/limitations.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Deployer use and operational obligations
items.objective: Assess applicable deployment responsibilities in actual use.

procedures.text: Observe use against provider instructions and authorized context.
Inspect oversight assignments, suitable input-data controls and monitoring.
Assess relevant notices, record retention and escalation responsibilities.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Fundamental-rights impact assessment applicability
items.objective: Assess whether a FRIA is required and evaluate the scoped process.

procedures.text: Approve role/use-based applicability against current text.
Where relevant, inspect affected groups, impacts, consultation, mitigations and reporting obligations.
Evaluate updates following deployment or risk changes; link to privacy impact work without conflating them.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Conformity route, standards and registration
items.objective: Assess applicable conformity and registration evidence without issuing unsupported certificates.

procedures.text: Determine applicable route and responsible authorized persons or notified body where required.
Verify standards/solutions, publication/citation status and applicability of claimed presumption.
Inspect provider declarations, marking and registration evidence where applicable.
Document gaps and separate this audit's scope from statutory certification.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Specific transparency obligations
items.objective: Assess applicable transparency duties separately from high-risk routing.

procedures.text: Assess provider/deployer and use-based transparency applicability and transitions.
Inspect notices, content labeling/detection solutions or other required measures within scope.
Observe user-facing behavior and approved exceptions with legal rationale.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Post-market monitoring and serious incidents
items.objective: Assess monitoring, corrective action and incident escalation processes.

procedures.text: Inspect monitoring plan, signals, owners, thresholds and feedback into risks.
Sample incidents/complaints, triage, corrective actions and notifications where applicable.
Validate role-specific notification triggers and clocks using current legal rules.
Assess closure verification and reassessment after material events.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: AI literacy and personnel competence
items.objective: Assess applicable competence/literacy measures in context.

procedures.text: Identify people using or overseeing the system and relevant duties.
Inspect contextual training, technical knowledge and refresher/change processes.
Sample demonstrated competence and address gaps affecting oversight or use.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Evidence sufficiency and contradictions
items.objective: Evaluate reliable and sufficient evidence against scoped assertions.

procedures.text: Evaluate source, custody, integrity, relevance, period/version and completeness.
Resolve contradictions and seek corroboration for representations/interviews.
Assess scope limitations and additional procedures.
Approve assertion-level sufficiency before engagement conclusions.

items.title: Finding evaluation and aggregation
items.objective: Develop supported findings and evaluate systemic/combined effects.

procedures.text: Record criterion, condition, evidence, cause, effect and recommendation.
Justify severity using harm/rights and qualitative overrides.
Aggregate related deficiencies and retain diagnostic/manual distinctions.
Obtain management response and independently evaluate disagreements.

items.title: Report and Annex IV reconciliation
items.objective: Ensure the report accurately reflects approved work and scoped criteria.

procedures.text: Reconcile report findings/conclusion to approved paper and artifact revisions.
Disclose readiness, limitations, exclusions, criteria and assessment period.
Compile Annex IV index and accurately attribute supplied provider declarations.
Review management factual responses and subsequent events.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

items.title: Completion, issue and immutable package
items.objective: Authorize and seal the exact approved report package.

procedures.text: Validate independent review, cleared blocking comments and current exact-revision approvals.
Check complete controls or approved disclosed limitations.
Hash/sign exported bytes and manifest; pin content/rule/model/data/run versions.
Verify recipient permissions, release record and retention/legal hold.
Reject issue if blocking conditions remain.

Assess design/operating evidence and approve a focused retest.
Evaluate regressions and residual risks; distinguish acceptance from verified closure.
Independently approve closure or retain open status with rationale.

Assign signal owner, response targets, evidence retention and escalation.
Define reassessment for changes in purpose, roles, population, system and law.
Create new monitoring records without amending sealed reports.

items.signOffGate: Independent reviewer clears blocking notes and approves the exact revision; lead approval where material.

Resolve conditions or approve explicit conditional acceptance.
Bind lead decision to the memo revision.
